title: Decision in Zeynep Aydemir case
paragraphs: The decision has been made in the trial of Black Sea Agenda correspondent Zeynep Aydemir on charge of spreading false information publicly. The result is that the verdict will be dropped (HAGB).

According to the indictment, Zeynep Aydemir released information that would mislead the public with the news of the deaths of intensive care in the state hospital published on August 30, 2025. The sentence is carried out: Turkish Penal Code 217/A (the public spread of misleading information publicly).
The verdict has been issued by the Zonguldak 3rd Criminal Court on May 14, 2026, which has not yet been issued.
In the case of Zeynep Aydemir, Attorney Selma Cakir has asked that the trial be concluded in a reasonable time, saying the case has not been concluded for two years.
Zeynep Aydemir works as a journalist for Zonguldak in the Black Sea Agenda broadcaster. The press professions have announced that they are closely monitoring the case.
There will be an appeal against the decision, and Zeynep Aydemir is free to go.
